A note from your favourite human

For you, Ananya

Some things deserve more than a text message. So here's a little letter, saved in your very own corner of the internet.

Dear Ananya,

Happy birthday to the sweetest, funniest, most wonderfully unpredictable person. Life is brighter, louder, and a whole lot more entertaining with you in it.

Thank you for being you — for the laughs, the little moments, the memories, and even the occasional drama. You have a way of making ordinary days feel special, and I hope you never forget how loved you are.

May this new chapter bring you soft mornings, big dreams, beautiful surprises, endless confidence, and every bit of happiness your heart can hold.

Keep shining, keep laughing, and please remain at least a little bit of a monkey. It is part of your charm. 🐵

Here's to you, today and always. Love you loads. ♡

Your favourite sibling ♡
